scope: Supplementary source discovery and reuse screening. No photograph was published from these pages.

sources.review: Official DOT publication footer contains both a general public-domain-unless-stated notice and an all-rights-reserved copyright notice. No individual target-place photograph and explicit rights-holder grant were established from this material. Government affiliation was not treated as permission.

Tour-operator media-kit search surfaced photography links for Boracay activities, not an individually licensed exact-venue image for these gaps. The presence of a media-kit download was not treated as a grant for Lakbay publication and cropping. No kit image was copied.
The public press-center archive directs image licensing enquiries to its media-library contact. No image permission was assumed and no enquiry was sent.

A Nonie's restaurant article illustrates dishes with credited Pixabay/Pexels material. Those generic food photographs do not establish the exact Nonie's Ondus venue and were not reused as documentary images.
An exact Tambisaan beach/jetty photograph was found, but its individual Flickr page states All rights reserved. Rejected; no permission request was sent.

networkLimitation.attempts: Official photo HTML and individual license metadata were accessible. Image retrieval timed out using Node fetch, a standard Flickr farm alias, and PowerShell Invoke-WebRequest. An official download endpoint returned HTTP 404. Repeated attempts were stopped.
networkLimitation.handling: Flickr candidates without a viewable file remain unapproved; no thumbnail, proxy, unrelated image or unverifiable substitute was published. Existing licensed Commons copies of Flickr photos were usable through Commons delivery where their individual image pages and subjects could be reviewed.
